_README: This is the schema. Copy to canonical.json and fill in as the runbook
produces each value; canonical.json IS committed — it is the address book
the whole verify-only reproducer mode reads.
1. Every value here is copied from a confirmed on-chain or Studio
result, never from a plan. If a step has not run, leave the field
null. A wrong address recorded here becomes a wrong address in
2. No secrets. Not the deployer key, not the stream key, not the
gateway API key. The stream keyfile lives outside the repository
recordedBy: program owner (assembled by session from confirmed on-chain/Studio results)

chain.name: sepolia
chain.note: Ethereum Sepolia. Contracts live here. Subgraphs are PUBLISHED on Arbitrum One (the mainnet protocol, real GRT) — publish chain and indexed chain are different things.

protocol.note: Query shape: POST {gateway}/api/subgraphs/id/{subgraphId} or /api/deployments/id/{deploymentId}, with 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

contracts.verifierNote: MockVerifier always returns true. This deployment is NOT evidence that the PoC's ZK layer works. See items/01-private-bond-replay/deploy/script/DeploySepolia.s.sol for why it is also currently unsatisfiable.

lifecycleTxs.mintBatchTransferAtomicSwap: confirmed on-chain pre-maturity (6 commitments, transfer root verified in knownRoots)

seed.lifecycleStatus: COMPLETE — all five entry points on-chain; 04-verify-chain.sh PASS 2026-07-29 (5/5 roots in knownRoots, 8 leaves)

artifacts.note: Regenerable byte-for-byte with: bond-replay seed-fixtures --maturity <maturityDate>. Publish these alongside canonical.json so a Mode-A reproducer has the disclosed set without re-deriving it.

subgraph.variantNote: 'call-handlers' is the primary design. 'fallback-a' means the ASSUMPTION-002 gate failed and the block-handler + eth_call design became the default (spec §4.6).

contracts.selectorNote: postAnchor(bytes). The contract is permissionless: anyone may post. The index reports what the chain contains and the checker adjudicates.

edgeCases.note: Deliberate. They make the canonical index visibly report MalformedAnchor and duplicateCount rather than dropping them. Both are notes in the checker, not failures.

stream.keyfileLocation: OUTSIDE the repository — recorded here as a description, never a copy. Default: $HOME/.graph-privacy-showcase/canonical/item02-stream-keyfile.json
stream.disclosureNote: The disclosure bundle contains the stream key by design — it is what makes a stranger's verification possible. Publishing it means anyone can post conflicting anchors at existing seqs; the checker flags those as CONFLICT.
stream.verifyStatus: 03-verify-chain.sh PASS 2026-07-29 — raw block scan blocks 11376124..11376337: 10/10 records match anchors, contiguous, hash chain holds; duplicate + malformed edge cases recorded
stream.disclosureLocation: OUTSIDE the repository by design (bundle contains the stream key): $HOME/.graph-privacy-showcase/canonical/item02-disclosure/ {keyfile.json, manifest.json, records.jsonl}

subgraph.variantNote: 'shape-1-calldata' is the primary design. 'shape-2-eventful' means the ASSUMPTION-002 gate failed and the contract gained an event (spec §4.6) — at which point E4's wording changes from 'pure calldata' to 'calldata + event' in the same session.

assumption002.upgradeIndexerObserved: 0xbdfb5ee5a2abf4fc7bb1bd1221067aef7f9de491 (allocated 1 GRT to both within minutes of publish; serving with attestations via targeted route; does NOT count toward the two)
assumption002.note: Run deploy/smoke-assumption-002.sh --item 01 and --item 02. The upgrade indexer is recorded but never counted toward the two.

firstLiveAttestations: 2026-07-29: gateway queries on both deployments returned graph-attestation headers (EIP-712, requestCID/responseCID bound); targeted per-indexer route confirmed working in production; bundles in deploy/evidence/assumption-002/
